name: Electrical substation (pole, kiosk, indoor, outdoor AIS, GIS)

types.pole: Pole-mounted 11/0.4 kV, 25-200 kVA (single pole up to 63 kVA, H-pole from 100 kVA)
types.kiosk: Compact kiosk 11/0.4 kV, 200-1600 kVA (RMU + transformer + LT panel)
types.indoor: Indoor building 11/0.4 kV, 500-2000 kVA, 1 or 2 transformer rooms
types.ais: Outdoor air-insulated yard 33/11 kV (5-20 MVA) or 132/33 kV (20-63 MVA) with control building
types.gis: Indoor GIS hall 33/11 or 132/33 kV + outdoor transformers + control building

rules.transformer_gap: with fire wall 5 m (33/11) / 8 m (132/33); without 10 m / 15 m
rules.oil_pit: transformer plan + 1 m each side, depth from 100 % of the oil at 40 % gravel void
rules.indoor: 0.9 m wall clearance, 1.5 m in front and 1.0 m behind MV panels
rules.live_parts: at least 3.7 m (33 kV) / 5.2 m (132 kV) above ground, insulator bottom at least 2.4 m
